title: The Postponed Seminar
story: Priya arrived for the afternoon seminar and found a notice on the classroom door. The tutor had postponed the session until Thursday because the projector was being repaired. Students who needed the recording could collect a link from the office before closing time. Priya copied the new time into her planner and texted her project partner, who had already left campus.

vocabulary.definition: A class in which a small group discusses a subject.
A short written message put where people can read it.
A machine that throws an image onto a screen.
A saved copy of a class that can be watched later.
A book or tool used to keep track of dates and tasks.

quiz.question: Why was the afternoon session moved?
options: The projector was being repaired
The classroom door had been removed
The office had closed for the month
Her partner had already left campus
quiz.explanation: The tutor postponed the session because the projector was being repaired.
quiz.supportingSentence: The tutor had postponed the session until Thursday because the projector was being repaired.

quiz.question: What problem did the door notice save Priya from?
options: Waiting for a class that was not happening that day
Repairing the projector by herself
Teaching the seminar with no partner
Missing a recording that was due that morning
quiz.correctAnswer: Waiting for a class that was not happening that day
quiz.explanation: The session had been moved to Thursday, so the afternoon class she came for was not on.
quiz.supportingSentence: The tutor had postponed the session until Thursday because the projector was being repaired.

quiz.question: Why was a text more useful than the door notice for her partner?
options: The partner had already left and would not see the door
The partner was busy repairing the projector
The office had asked her to send the recording
The planner could not store a new time
quiz.correctAnswer: The partner had already left and would not see the door
quiz.explanation: Her project partner had already left campus, so he would not read the notice on the door.
quiz.supportingSentence: Priya copied the new time into her planner and texted her project partner, who had already left campus.

quiz.question: What does postponed mean in this story?
options: Moved to a later time
Cancelled and never repeated
Filmed for the office
Copied into a planner
quiz.explanation: The session was postponed until Thursday, so it was delayed rather than cancelled.
quiz.supportingSentence: The tutor had postponed the session until Thursday because the projector was being repaired.

quiz.question: Why does the notice tell students about a link?
options: So anyone who needs the recording can still get it
So the tutor can sell the projector
So Priya will leave campus early
So the classroom door can stay shut
quiz.correctAnswer: So anyone who needs the recording can still get it
quiz.explanation: The link from the office is for students who needed the recording of the session.
quiz.supportingSentence: Students who needed the recording could collect a link from the office before closing time.
